message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul && grep -RIn "TODO\|FIXME\|strcpy\|memcpy\|gets\|scanf\|sprintf\|system\|malloc\|free\|read\|fread\|parse" . | head -200` executed with exit code 0.

function.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && cat description.txt && printf '\\n---\\n' && find repo-vul -maxdepth 3 -type f | sed 's#^./##' | sort | head -200"}
function.name: execute_bash
